surface: Runtime @unhead/react hooks, Head, Helmet, and client/server UnheadProvider over the unchanged unhead@3.3.2 core. ./utils is a verbatim unhead/utils re-export.
divergences: Head and Helmet cannot inspect TSRX block children; consumers pass children={createElement(...)} or an array of createElement host tags.
./bundler, ./vite, ./stream/vite, and ./plugins are compiler/bundler plugins and are not ported.
./stream/server and ./stream/client wrap React streaming (renderToPipeableStream) and are not ported.
ssr: Supported. Server UnheadProvider takes a required value. Client entries are created in useEffect and disposed on unmount; SSR still pushes during render when head.ssr is set.
notes: Verified with UnheadProvider + useHead title updates, Head createElement children, useSeoMeta, and unmount dispose.
